metadata.title: Taxonomy for Privacy-Preserving Electronic Identities
metadata.description:
We present a taxonomy of digital identity systems as a discussion foundation. This taxonomy defines the desired properties, the available cryptographic techniques, as well as the legal and technical frameworks relevant to building digital identity systems.

This is a draft. Later versions will add evaluation metrics and apply them to the Swiss and EU e-ID systems.
